goal: Iske baad aap structures ke array aur uski count ko aise functions mein pass kar sakte hain jo records read, print, search aur best record dhoondte hain, aur aap jaante hain ke original array kyun badal jata hai.
warmup: Ek class teacher ke paas ek register hai jis mein 50 students ke records hain. Woh wohi EK register clerk ko deti hai ke bonus marks add kare, aur agle din coordinator ko deti hai ke toppers print kare. Koi pehle saare 50 safhon ki photocopy nahi karta. Register (array) har shakhs ke paas jata hai, saath mein ek parchi hoti hai jis par likha hota hai ke kitne safhe bhare hain (count).
definition: Structures ka array kisi bhi array ki tarah function mein pass hota hai: call mein array ka naam likhein aur function header mein parameter Type list[] likhein. Function ko pehle record ka address milta hai, is liye koi copy nahi banti aur function ORIGINAL array par kaam karta hai: function return hone ke baad bhi tabdeeliyan rehti hain. Array apna size saath nahi rakhta, is liye count n doosre argument ke tor par pass hota hai. Jab function sirf records parhe to const Type list[] use karein.
howItWorks: Trace ko step by step dekhein. addBonus mein parameter list, cls ki copy nahi hai: yeh wohi array hai. Is liye list[0].marks += 5 main mein cls[0].marks ko badal deta hai. n aam int hai, is liye woh copy HOTA hai. Aam kaam isi pattern par chalte hain. Array MEIN parhna: function cin se list[i].name aur list[i].marks bharta hai aur return karta hai ke kitne records parhe. Print: ek loop jo har record dikhata hai, const ke saath. Search: ek loop jo list[i].name ko key se compare karta hai aur index i return karta hai, ya -1 jab kuch match na ho. Best record: ek variable best mein ab tak ke best record ka index rakhein, aur jab bhi behtar record mile usay update karein. Menu in sab ko jorta hai: do-while loop choice parhta hai aur switch har case ke liye ek function call karta hai. Yaad rakhein ke array ka size tay hai, is liye n ko hamesha us size se zyada na hone dein.
